title: buzz-disable-conformance-probe
description:
Git change (user-approved remedy for structural blocker on tk-xfv): set BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE=false in the buzz deployment env so the relay can serve on GCS S3-interop (no CAS; upstream block/buzz#2470, fix pending in PR #2511).
Locate the env block: k8s/charts/buzz/ templates (deployment/statefulset) or the buzz Application values in k8s/applications/buzz.yaml / .submodules/home-systems-values. Add the env var alongside the existing BUZZ_* vars with a comment citing: 'A3 git conformance probe is unsatisfiable on GCS S3-interop (429 mutation limiter + no If-Match CAS, upstream block/buzz#2470); re-enable when chart with git.conformanceProbe knob (upstream PR #2511) lands'.
Keep the probe name/style consistent with how other BUZZ_* env vars are declared in that file.
Do NOT apply to the cluster; commit in worktree only.
ACCEPTANCE: render (helm template or manifest parse) shows the env var on the buzz workload; no other changes; diff committed on branch; evidence comment.

comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
DONE: Disabled buzz A3 git conformance probe in k8s/applications/buzz.yaml (commit 77e64d4b, branch buzz-disable-conformance-probe).

Change: added relay.extraEnv: [{name: BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE, value: \false\}] to the chart 0.1.7 valuesObject, placed after persistence.git with the requested citation (GCS S3-interop: 429 mutation limiter + no If-Match CAS, upstream block/buzz#2470; re-enable when git.conformanceProbe knob lands in upstream PR #2511).

Why relay.extraEnv: pulled oci://ghcr.io/block/buzz/charts/buzz 0.1.7 and verified it has no git.conformanceProbe values knob and never sets BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE itself; relay.extraEnv is the chart's sanctioned passthrough appended into the relay container env block (templates/deployment.yaml), so the var lands without duplicate-key collision. Chart schema validated strict-render OK.

Verification (render-only, per repo GitOps rules — no kubectl apply): helm template buzz oci://ghcr.io/block/buzz/charts/buzz --version 0.1.7 with the full valuesObject + private s3.bucket renders cleanly; yq confirms exactly one env entry name: BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE / value: \false\ in the rendered Deployment, positioned after the chart-owned BUZZ_* vars; buzz.yaml parses as valid YAML with the values intact. No push/merge — branch awaits review.
